admin_settings_owner_placeholder: Shown on the About page; defaults to Site Name
admin_settings_auto_resync_desc: When on, new stickers in your Telegram packs are pulled in daily (via a scheduled job).
admin_settings_registry_overrides: Let the registry update my linked artists
admin_settings_registry_overrides_desc: When on, syncing overwrites a linked artist's name, avatar, and socials with the registry's. Off keeps your local edits and only fills empty fields.
admin_settings_registry_not_connected: Not connected. Pull shared artist data and submit your own by connecting below.
admin_settings_ut_leftover_pre: UploadThing still holds {size} of pre-migration originals. Delete them on the
admin_settings_provider_desc_pre: Where new images (gallery + fursuit photos) are uploaded and served. Your initial provider is set up by the setup CLI; switch here to migrate to the other one. First make sure the target's credentials exist (the R2
admin_settings_provider_desc_mid2: secret) — see the status below. Switching only changes where
admin_settings_provider_desc_post: uploads go; run a migration to move existing images too.
admin_settings_r2_not_configured: Not configured — add the IMAGES R2 binding in wrangler.toml
admin_settings_ut_not_set: Not set — add UPLOADTHING_TOKEN as a secret
admin_settings_registry_sync_desc: Pull artist updates from the shared registry now, and link any local artists already in it. (This also runs on a schedule via the sync cron.)
admin_settings_registry_secret_post: deploy secret. Manage it wherever you set your deploy secrets.
admin_settings_registry_forkkey_desc: Connected with an in-app fork key (stored in your site's database). Disconnecting clears the key; your linked artists keep their current data.
admin_settings_registry_connect_failed: Could not connect to the registry
admin_settings_registry_connect_desc: The shared registry is a curated, opt-in directory of artists so you don't re-enter the same people on every fork. Ask the registry maintainer for an invite token, paste it here, and we'll register this site and store its key — no CLI or redeploy.
admin_settings_invite_token_placeholder: paste the token the maintainer gave you
admin_settings_registry_url_hint: Only change this if you run your own registry instance.
admin_settings_forkkey_hint: The fork key is stored in your site's database (not a deploy secret). It's a low-privilege, revocable, submit-only key.
admin_settings_export_desc: Download a full backup of all images, metadata, collections, and tags as a JSON file.
admin_settings_clear_all_desc: Delete all images, collections, and tags. This cannot be undone.
admin_settings_clear_cache_card_desc: Remove orphaned files from your storage (R2 and UploadThing) that are no longer referenced in your database.
admin_settings_reset_tags_card_desc: Remove all tags from images. Images and collections are preserved.
admin_settings_delete_all_message: This will delete ALL images, collections, tags, characters, and artists. Files will also be removed from your storage (R2 and UploadThing). This cannot be undone.
admin_settings_clear_cache_message: This will find files in your storage (R2 and UploadThing) that are no longer referenced in your database and delete them. Useful for cleaning up orphaned uploads.
admin_settings_reset_tags_message: This will remove all tags from all images. Images and collections are preserved. This cannot be undone.
